formacion.title: Learning fast is the skill that decides who adapts to AI.
formacion.lede: I've been a professor at Universidad EAFIT for 15 years and building software and AI for 13. I bring both crafts together in Learning Sprints for teams and live cohorts for professionals, with a method tested in the classroom and in production.

method.label: // the method
method.title: The MAPA Method
method.desc: Four steps to learn any skill in weeks, not months. It combines ultralearning principles, experiential learning, and AI as a tutor.

steps.title: Map
steps.text: Break the skill down and find the 20% that delivers 80% of the result.

steps.title: Apply
steps.text: Practice from day one on a real project, not in theory.

steps.title: Practice the hard parts
steps.text: Isolated drills on weak spots and active recall so it sticks.

steps.title: Adjust
steps.text: Fast feedback, with AI as a tutor, iterating every week.

offers.label: // how we work
offers.title: Two ways to learn with me

items.title: Learning Sprints
items.text: Four-week remote programs that take your team from theory to using a new skill in their real work, including AI adoption.
bullets: Facilitated live sessions and challenges built on your company's real cases
Standalone workshops from 90 minutes to half a day
Tailored proposal based on team size and goals

items.title: Live cohorts
items.text: Small groups that learn a skill in 4 to 6 weeks with the MAPA Method, guidance, and community.
bullets: AI as a tutor, with tested prompts and routines
Next cohort: message me to join the waitlist

mapa.title: Skill map in 20 minutes
mapa.lede: Pick something you want to learn in the next 30 days. Go through the four stations, 5 minutes each, and you'll end with a concrete plan.
howto: 3 · Copy your plan or get it by email
mapa.loadExample: See a filled-in example (SQL for work)

goal.title: Your goal
goal.hint: What you want to be able to do, not what you want to "study".
goal.outcomeHint: Something another person can see or use.
goal.outcomePh: E.g. build the monthly sales report on my own
goal.whyPh: E.g. I take over reports in January

map.title: Map
map.hint: Break the skill into pieces. Then star the 3 that give you the most results.

apply.title: Apply
apply.hint: You learn by doing. Define the real project you'll build from day one.

practice.title: Practice the hard parts
practice.hint: Isolate what's hardest and practice it alone. Test yourself without your notes.

adjust.title: Adjust
adjust.hint: Without feedback you repeat mistakes. Decide who or what corrects you and when you review the plan.

fields.projectHint: Small, useful and finished in 30 days.
fields.projectPh: E.g. a dashboard with last quarter's sales by region
fields.firstStepPh: E.g. install DBeaver and connect to the test database
fields.weakPh: E.g. understanding JOINs across several tables
fields.drillPh: E.g. 10 short JOIN exercises, 15 minutes a day
fields.recall: 3 questions to test yourself every week
fields.recallHint: Answering from memory makes learning stick better than rereading.
fields.feedbackPh: E.g. the team's senior analyst + AI as a tutor

result.label: // result
result.title: Your 30-day plan
result.hint: It builds itself from what you wrote.

email.title: Get your plan by email
email.hint: I'll send it so it doesn't get lost.

email.error: I couldn't send the plan. Make sure there are no links in the fields and try again.

plan.heading: MAPA PLAN · 30 DAYS
plan.week3: {piece} + bring it all into the project
plan.week4: Finish, show the result and ask for feedback
plan.mapPrompt:
Act as an expert in {skill} and as a teacher.
My 30-day goal: {outcome}.
I have {hours} hours per week.

1. Break the skill into 10 to 15 concrete pieces (concepts, procedures and tools).
2. Mark the 3 pieces that bring me closest to my goal and explain why.
3. Tell me what I can ignore for now without hurting the result.
plan.tutorPrompt:
You are my {skill} tutor. My goal: {outcome}.
Every time I write to you, ask me 3 recall questions about {topics},
one at a time and without giving me the answer. After each answer, correct me,
tell me what reasoning mistake I made and suggest a short exercise to practice that point.

newsletter.confirmText: Once you confirm, I won't write to you again. You can subscribe again anytime from the MAPA template.
